entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: A living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam that can compel a wizard to obey another, or give or take away the ability to manipulate mana.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The sages of the College of Lat-Nam who built the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Brothers' War was fought.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A planeswalker who used the Stone Brain against evil wizards and kept its last secret.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Companion of Greensleeves who found the Brain's punishment too cruel.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A wizard who retrieved the Stone Brain believing it to be a mana vault.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A wizard enslaved by the Brain who summoned Phyrexian Gremlins.

entities.name: Dacian
entities.description: A wizard who once battled Towser over White Ridge, captured by the army.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: A wizard who joined the alliance against Gull and Greensleeves.

entities.name: Tybalt
entities.description: A student of magic whose incident revealed how the Brain worked.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: Person who considered the Stone Brain the most powerful artifact in Dominarian history.

entities.name: Phyrexian Gremlins
entities.description: Creatures summoned by Haakon that snatched the artifact.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: Forest where the Stone Brain fell as a falling star.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Long-lost isle and college where the Stone Brain was built and its secret lay.

events.summary: The sages of Lat-Nam build the Stone Brain; they fight over it, then enclose it in a box and launch it into space.
events.quote: the sages enclosed it in a box and launched it into space

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves see the Brain fall as a star; Towser retrieves it, thinking it a mana vault.
events.quote: the wizard Towser retrieved it with their help, believing it to be a mana vault

events.summary: The Brain's workings are revealed; Haakon is tested and becomes Greensleeves' slave.
events.quote: he became a sort of slave to Greensleeves

events.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Brain; Greensleeves planeswalks to it and finds she can resist its voices.
events.quote: she found out that she could resist the voices

events.summary: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on him; Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek Karli and Towser.
events.quote: Dacian and Haakon formed a truce

events.summary: Greensleeves dons the helmet and learns its ultimate secret lies in the ruins of Lat-Nam.
Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic; Gull lets the others keep magic only for good; Greensleeves keeps the last secret to herself.
events.quote: Greensleeves used the Stone Brain to strip Towser of his magic

relations.quote: created by the Sages of Lat-Nam
Gull confronted Greensleeves about using the Stone Brain
they ended up fighting each other
